head: 76546c649f6e7a7fe12ae91f7c41f0104ca73d31
summary:
SL-098 holds against the real C:\WINDOWS\TEMP on this PC, which this user cannot list, against a real cldflt sync root, and against the published app on the interactive desktop. Everything below was run as sshub, unelevated, in pwsh 7.6.6, at HEAD 76546c6. The tree was unchanged afterwards.

**RuleCases**
- `-Case All` with the engine python, through SL-098-RuleCasesUnderTemps.Tests.ps1, exits 0 with 'All checks held.' under TEMP=TMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP (361 s). It does the same under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp (363 s).
- In both runs the scratch line reports the TEMP that was asked for, the root fsa-rulecases-<hex> sits in LocalAppData\Temp, and the root is gone afterwards.
- No line says 'Access is denied', 'stopped:', 'cleanup:' or FAIL.

**Helper and return-value tests**, all under TEMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP: TempRoots (39 ok), ReturnValues and SL-076 each exit 0.

**Independent probes I wrote**
- O-014, the junction question. I extracted Remove-ScratchDir from RuleCases.ps1 and fed it a scratch tree holding:
  - a read-only file;
  - plain junctions, a junction marked read-only and a nested junction, all pointing to an outside folder that holds read-only files;
  - under pwsh 7, a folder symlink and a file symlink as well.
  
  I ran it under pwsh 7 and powershell.exe 5.1, each with a listable parent and with a Deny-ListDirectory parent. In all 4 runs the outside files survived and kept their read-only attribute, so nothing crossed a link.
  - The one gap: a junction that is itself read-only is not unlinked. It is left behind with one counted 'cleanup:' FAIL and nothing is thrown. Nobody asked for this case, so it is filed as extra.
- Criterion 13: I killed `RuleCases -Case C-004` mid-run under C:\WINDOWS\TEMP. It left fsa-rulecases-<hex> in LocalAppData\Temp, findable, with 3 parity folders inside and none of their names directly in C:\WINDOWS\TEMP. I then deleted that root with the helper.
- Criterion 14: under a 200-character TEMP, B-008 gives the named refusal 'case setup: B-008 case folder too long for a 250-character root', and no Substring exception.

**WindowCases**
- SL-098-B008Root.Tests.ps1 -Temp Both: the root is 250 characters and title+detail is 428 under both TEMPs. PASSED.
- WindowMutants -Mutant All, which Q-114 requires: exit 0, all 12 mutants PASSED (415 s).

**Core tests**
- The whole default suite under TEMP=TMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP: 805 passed, 0 failed.
- The opt-in Cloud=CF-SYNC-ROOT rig, run 3 times in a row under TEMP=TMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP as Q-086 allows:
  - every run exits 0 with 4 Facts passed, and the stall Fact's teardown is PENDING, which shows the killed-provider case was fed;
  - the providers registered their roots in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp\fsa-tests\fsa-cf-<pid>-<guid>;
  - after each run there is no fsa-cf-* folder there and no CfProvider process. The sync-root count stays at 1 total with 0 belonging to the rig, read through the WinRT GetCurrentSyncRoots call.
  
  This settles Derived 7 and the run that was waived as O-026 / SC-226.

**Fitness:** op=check passes all 88 rules.

**Acceptance test:** I did not re-run it. The engine's recorded run of it (O-001) exited 0.

**Leftovers seen:** four fsa-rulecases-* roots already in LocalAppData\Temp (140–141 folders each) were made by runs before mine. Each started exactly 2 minutes after the one before, which looks like `-Case All` runs being killed by a 120 s timeout in whatever ran them. That is the killed-run shape criterion 13 describes, not a failed cleanup. My complete runs left nothing.

**Assumed:** the bug report had only its title. I took the slice description and the investigation as the specification.

criteria.criterion: 1. run a RuleCases harness case — harness exits non-zero, scratch directly in a create-but-not-list TEMP outside the Windows folder, run root in that TEMP
criteria.how: The engine's own recorded run of tests/bugs/SL-098-RuleCasesUnlistableTemp.Tests.ps1 exited 0 (O-001, on the record). I did not re-run it. Supporting evidence of my own: the helper removed a tree containing a read-only file under a Deny-ListDirectory parent outside the Windows folder, in my probe under pwsh 7 and powershell.exe 5.1, and in TempRoots.

criteria.criterion: 2. run every RuleCases case under the engine's TEMP (TEMP=TMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP)
criteria.how: SL-098-RuleCasesUnderTemps.Tests.ps1 -Temp Engine, Case All, with the %APPDATA%\taad3\venv python against the real C:\WINDOWS\TEMP: exit 0 in 361 s. 'All checks held.' No Access denied, stopped:, cleanup: or FAIL line. It saw TEMP C:\WINDOWS\TEMP\. Root fsa-rulecases-ee03356810 was in LocalAppData\Temp and gone afterwards.

criteria.criterion: 3. run every RuleCases case with an ordinary TEMP (Derived 3)
criteria.how: SL-098-RuleCasesUnderTemps.Tests.ps1 -Temp Ordinary: exit 0 in 363 s. 'All checks held.' It saw TEMP C:\Users\sshub\AppData\Local\Temp\. Root fsa-rulecases-cfca3f407c was gone afterwards.

criteria.criterion: 4. remove a scratch folder — read-only file, parent cannot be listed
criteria.how: TempRoots under TEMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP: 39 ok, exit 0. My own probe had a\ro.txt (+R) in scratch under a Deny-ListDirectory parent, and it was removed under both shells. Only the separate read-only junction stayed, see the extra check.

criteria.criterion: 5. remove a scratch folder — junction to an outside folder holding a read-only file
criteria.how: My probe ran 4 times (pwsh 7 and 5.1, each with a listable and a deny-list parent). Junctions j1, j2ro and nested\deeper\j3 were in place, plus a folder symlink and a file symlink under pwsh 7. Afterwards outside\ro.txt and outside\sub\deep.txt still existed and were still +R, plain.txt existed, and the outside folder's attributes were unchanged. TempRoots' junction checks also pass.

criteria.criterion: 6. remove a scratch folder — already gone
criteria.how: TempRoots under C:\WINDOWS\TEMP passes its missing-folder and removed-twice checks (exit 0). The code returns early when Directory.Exists is false.

criteria.criterion: 7. remove a scratch folder — file held open with FileShare.None
criteria.how: TempRoots line 'a held file is counted once, naming the folder' (cleanup: ...\held: The process cannot access the file 'leaf.txt'...), and ReturnValues D07 shows exactly 1 FAIL line, counted once. Both exit 0.

criteria.criterion: 8. WindowCases B-008 title length under TEMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP (case folder 65)
criteria.how: SL-098-B008Root.Tests.ps1 -Temp Both, engine half, published exe and hook on the interactive desktop: B-008 exit 0, no FAIL line, root 250 and 250, title+detail 428 and 428.

criteria.criterion: 9. WindowCases B-008 title length under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp (case folder 83)
criteria.how: Same run, ordinary half: root 250, length 428 and 428, equal to the engine half. 'All checks held', exit 0, 64 s for both halves.

WindowMutants.ps1 -Mutant All: exit 0 in 415 s. 'PASSED: StopDisabled, StopCollapsed, NoCrashHandler, NoExitRule, CancelThrows, HookFailsAfterActing, HookCompileError, HookLocked, EndingObeysSkip, ListingFailsAnyFolder, NoFailListingMember, NoExplorerViewMember' (Q-114).

criteria.criterion: 11. choose the cloud rig's parent folder when TEMP is C:\WINDOWS\TEMP
criteria.how: Whole default suite under TEMP=TMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP: 805 passed, 0 failed (it includes the PrepareParent Fact). The real opt-in Cloud=CF-SYNC-ROOT rig, 3 runs under TEMP=TMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP: each exit 0 with 4 Facts passed. Providers became ready on C:\Users\sshub\AppData\Local\Temp\fsa-tests\fsa-cf-<pid>-<guid>. After each run there was no fsa-cf-* in fsa-tests, no CfProvider process, and no rig-like sync root registered.

criteria.criterion: 12. find the cloud rig's roots from WindowCases when TEMP is at or under the Windows folder
criteria.how: Met as amended by the decided finding M1 (O-016): WindowCases does not look for SyncRootRig's roots. The build left this code unchanged, and I checked it by reading only. Get-CloudCaseBase (WindowCases.ps1:5683-5690) already moves a TEMP under the Windows folder to LocalAppData\Temp\fsa-window-cloud. Clear-StaleCloudRoots (:5748) lists only that base, after an Exists guard. Neither lists GetTempPath(). The opt-in N-006 window case that uses them was not run.

criteria.criterion: 13. run RuleCases — the run is killed before its finally
criteria.how: I started RuleCases -Case C-004 under TEMP=TMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP and killed its process tree once 3 case folders existed. It left C:\Users\sshub\AppData\Local\Temp\fsa-rulecases-259106a556, holding 3 fsa-parity-case-* folders. None of those names exist directly in C:\WINDOWS\TEMP (Test-Path by name). No stray process remained. I then deleted the root with the helper.

criteria.criterion: 14. WindowCases B-008 root — case folder 249 characters or longer
criteria.how: WindowCases.ps1 -Case B-008 with TEMP=TMP set to a 200-character folder: '  FAIL  case setup: B-008 case folder too long for a 250-character root: <case>' and 'FAILED: B-008', exit 1, after 2 s. No Substring exception and no app launch.

checks.what: Removal helper shapes, return-value census and the SL-076 regression, under C:\WINDOWS\TEMP

checks.what: O-014: does the helper (first .NET recursive delete, then the hand walk) cross a junction or symlink into an outside folder? Independent probe extracted from RuleCases.ps1 by AST

checks.evidence: 4 of 4 runs: outside ro.txt=True/R:True, plain=True, deep=True/R:True, outside folder attributes 'Directory' before and after. Nothing crossed a link. The deny-list parent was confirmed 'list-denied' before the call. All probe folders were deleted afterwards.

checks.evidence: In all 4 runs scratch is left holding only \j2ro (ReadOnly, Directory, ReparsePoint), with exactly one counted '  FAIL  cleanup: ...\scratch: Access to the path 'j2ro' is denied.' and no throw and no crossing. Open-Tree unlinks reparse entries without first clearing ReadOnly on them. No RuleCases scratch makes such a link and nobody required this shape, so it goes to the backlog.

checks.command: TEMP=TMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP; 3x pwsh -File eng/dotnet.ps1 test tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests.csproj --filter Cloud=CF-SYNC-ROOT --logger 'console;verbosity=detailed'. Before and after each run: WinRT StorageProviderSyncRootManager.GetCurrentSyncRoots, fsa-tests listing, CfProvider processes
checks.evidence: Runs 1-3: exit 0, about 8 s each. Passed in each run: AProviderThatCannotStartFailsWithItsOwnError, AProviderThatCannotStartSilentlyIsKilledAndFails, DehydratedPlaceholdersAreTraversedWithTrueSizesAndNeverHydrated, StalledFetchIsFreedByCancelThroughTheShippedGuard. Each run printed 'provider pid N ready on C:\Users\sshub\AppData\Local\Temp\fsa-tests\fsa-cf-<pid>-<guid>' and 'teardown shape: PENDING' for the stall. Before and after every run: sync roots total=1, rig-like=0; fsa-tests fsa-cf-*: none; CfProvider running: 0; legacy fsa-cf-* directly in LocalAppData\Temp: 21 (untouched).

'88 rule(s) checked against 149 parsed file(s), 197 file(s) read. Every declared rule holds.' This includes the new 'RuleCases removes nothing with Remove-Item' rule, and the %SystemRoot%\Temp rule without the CloudPlaceholderTests.cs exemption.

checks.what: O-015: does any RuleCases case assume its New-TempDir scratch sits directly in GetTempPath()?
checks.command: Grep GetTempPath|env:TEMP|env:TMP|New-TempDir in tests/rules/RuleCases.ps1, plus the two -Case All runs
checks.evidence: Every New-TempDir caller (:182, :190, :237, :722-:791) uses the path it returns. The only remaining GetTempPath and env:TEMP reads are Get-ScratchParent's default (:80), the scratch line (:107), and the lookup of the harness's own kept fsa-rules-* folder (:277), which the harness child makes in its inherited TEMP. Both -Case All runs pass with every case folder one level deeper, at <root>\<case folder>.

checks.what: Leftover fsa-rulecases-* roots in LocalAppData\Temp from runs before this validation
checks.command: Get-ChildItem $env:LOCALAPPDATA\Temp -Filter fsa-rulecases-*, with creation and last-write times and child kinds
checks.evidence: Four roots, none from my runs: 0879ca0938 (06:13:44), 3bd86f4f0e (06:15:43), f851550a3a (06:46:35), 718ca6e849 (06:48:35). Each holds 6 fsa-engine-case and 134 fsa-parity-case folders (f851550a3a also holds 1 fsa-rules-case). Each run started exactly 2 minutes after the one before, against the roughly 6 minutes a full -Case All takes, so these look like runs killed by a 120 s timeout in whatever ran them. That is the designed killed-run shape (criterion 13), not a failed cleanup: both of my complete runs and every test left nothing. Whoever runs -Case All under a 2-minute limit should be on the backlog (compare Q-132). I did not delete them.
Not re-run by design. The engine's own run is on the record: O-001 exit 0, against exit 1 when the bug was reproduced.

checks.what: SettledCountProbe -Shape BothShells and RuleCases run whole under powershell.exe 5.1
checks.evidence: Not run by me; build and code review ran it under both TEMPs. Its 5.1 path is covered here only through my probe of the helper under powershell.exe 5.1, and through TempRoots' own 5.1 repeat.

Same as at the start: only the engine's index.json change and its untracked build and code-review records and .taad-scratch. My scratch folder %TEMP%\sl098-validate was deleted (exists=False) and no fsa-sl098-* folders were left.

obligations.evidence: Independent probe of Remove-ScratchDir, extracted from RuleCases.ps1 by AST, under pwsh 7.6.6 and powershell.exe 5.1, each with a listable and a Deny-ListDirectory parent. Scratch held a read-only file, which forces the fallback walk, plus junctions (one plain, one itself +R, one nested two levels down) to an outside folder holding +R files. Under pwsh 7 it also held a folder symlink and a file symlink. Afterwards, in all 4 runs, the outside files existed and kept +R, and the outside folder's attributes were unchanged. By reading: Open-Tree unlinks any ReparsePoint entry with a non-recursive Directory.Delete or File.Delete and never recurses into it; the top folder is deleted non-recursively when it is itself a reparse point. TempRoots' junction checks also pass under C:\WINDOWS\TEMP. Side finding, filed as extra: a junction marked read-only is left behind with a counted cleanup FAIL, still without crossing.

RuleCases -Case All (C-001..C-014) exits 0 with 'All checks held.' under both TEMP=TMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP and %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp, with every New-TempDir folder one level down in fsa-rulecases-<hex>. A grep of RuleCases.ps1 shows no case rebuilding a scratch path from GetTempPath(). The only GetTempPath and env:TEMP lookup outside Get-ScratchParent is for the harness child's own kept fsa-rules-* folder (:277).

not_reached: The engine's own stage-shell token and environment. My runs set TEMP=TMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP inside this user's interactive session. Two differences earlier stages flagged were not reproduced: SC-215 (Remove-Item denied under the engine token) and SC-216 (a possible TMPDIR in the stage shell).

Whether my Engine-TEMP -Case All run left any harness fsa-rules-* folder directly in C:\WINDOWS\TEMP. This user cannot list that folder, so the evidence is only that the helper printed no 'cleanup:' line. Older leftovers there (SC-214, Q-219, the build's fsa-settled-probe-*) still need an elevated listing by a person.
Windows 10: everything here ran on Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200. No Windows 10 machine exists (Q-205, Q-216).
The opt-in WindowCases cloud case N-006, which uses Get-CloudCaseBase and Clear-StaleCloudRoots, was not run. Criterion 12 rests on reading code this slice left unchanged.
SettledCountProbe -Shape BothShells, and a whole RuleCases run under powershell.exe 5.1, were not run by me. Build and code review ran them.

The 21 legacy fsa-cf-* folders directly in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp are untouched, because the routed rig no longer sweeps that location. GetCurrentSyncRoots shows none of them registered. Clearing them is the person's action under Q-218.

Four fsa-rulecases-* roots (140-141 folders each) were left in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp by runs before this validation that look killed at 2-minute intervals. Who ran them, and with what timeout, was not observed.
